Duelist’s Second

You checked straps, carried spare blades and stood ready when a formal duel became a messy fight. You learned both the invitation to a clean exchange and the value of armor when it fails.

Which duel should never have happened?

Rules

Choose one:

- Arms 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.5ee0ed01fff955fd.JournalEntryPage.c21c86fbb31c186c]{Invitation to the Blade}. - Armor 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1f6b36c34db9c5eb.JournalEntryPage.36ac9af60144cf5c]{Wear Light Armor}.

Type: Background

Each option is a pair. Duplicate grants give 1 level-0 DP each; no automatic higher rank. Follow the card’s equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +7 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
